detail: An occurrence records the fault code, steering system, model and software version.
The incident retains the vehicle identity and its fleet snapshot.
The incident retains the driver identity and vehicle association at intake.
An association records when a driver’s assignment starts and ends.
A notification links its incident to an approved remedy and delivery history.
Delivery follows the driver’s notification preferences and approved contact.
The message retains the exact fault publication and ontology version used.
Fault knowledge references an exact approved classification and version.
Symptoms describe the observed steering behavior associated with the fault.
Versioned fault knowledge contains remedy guidance and approval status.
An engineering case links the incident and investigation to resolution review.
